purpose: Dedicated section of improvement suggestions. Each suggestion is a proposal for review; none is implemented. Official links are context/verification targets, not endorsements.

suggestions.suggestion: Schedule an automated weekly refresh of the canonical snapshot (standings, schedule, scores, injuries) from official pages, producing dated snapshots and a change log.
suggestions.rationale: The canonical snapshot is a point-in-time extract; official pages change. A recurring, dated refresh keeps every table current and auditable.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a roster-depth tracking module that records starters versus 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements on offense and defense, using official sources (injury reports, transaction reports, and official gamebooks that list starters).
suggestions.rationale: The project must know deficiencies caused by backups replacing starters. Practice reports alone do not establish depth-chart roles; official gamebooks list starters and are the verifiable source.

suggestions.suggestion: Implement the leaderboard competition with pre-registered trials, proper scoring (Brier / log loss), fixed baselines, family-wise uncertainty adjustment, and paper-point rewards only after every applicable gate PASSes.
suggestions.rationale: Rewards must be skill-based and selective. Pre-registration and family-wise adjustment prevent luck-chasing and multiple-testing artifacts.

suggestions.suggestion: Compute bet-leg correlation values from aligned event-level data (same-game margin vs total residuals; cross-game independence tests) rather than team aggregates; keep unverified cells blank.
suggestions.rationale: Pairwise team correlations cannot price parlays or props. Event-level dependence is required, and unknown dependence must never be treated as independence.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a pre-decision checklist gate: no strategy, line, or flag promotion without all applicable validation gates G1-G8 PASS.
suggestions.rationale: Fail-closed enforcement prevents promotion on missing, conditional, stale or unverified evidence.

suggestions.suggestion: Add CSV export of verified table rows and a per-table 'last verified' timestamp; keep the existing row search/filter.
suggestions.rationale: Improves decision-making usability and makes data currency visible at the point of use.
suggestions.status: Proposed — partially implemented (search exists; export/timestamps not)

suggestions.suggestion: Show a snapshot-age indicator on every page and table caption (the nav footer already carries the snapshot date).
suggestions.rationale: Users must know data currency before making decisions based on the tables.

suggestions.suggestion: Transcribe the full official injury report for all games each week, with a normalized status vocabulary (Out / Doubtful / Questionable / full / limited / did not participate) and a roster-impact flag by position group.
suggestions.rationale: Current coverage is a bounded sample; full weekly coverage improves availability decisions and backup-replacement detection.

suggestions.suggestion: Maintain an auditable decision log recording each decision, its evidence, alternatives considered, and the outcome.
suggestions.rationale: Makes the suggestion -> review -> decision -> implementation path reviewable and repeatable.

suggestions.suggestion: Develop player-prop signals from Next Gen Stats (CPOE, intended air yards, separation, target share) with lagged features, validated out-of-sample.
suggestions.rationale: Supports the single-bet, parlay and player-prop strategy families with official, verifiable inputs.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a market-reference layer only if official or verifiable odds become available; otherwise keep all market values blank and blocked.
suggestions.rationale: Prevents promotion of unverified third-party prices (a prior audit finding). No -110 defaults or inferred prices.

suggestions.suggestion: Refresh the NGS weekly passing correlation library each week to build event-level evidence over time.
suggestions.rationale: Builds the aligned, timestamped dependence dataset needed to price combinations and validate independence assumptions.
